payload.title: cowork spawn-fanout Step 5.2 dispatches slot.flow_path, which bypasses the published-marker dedup gate for digest-daily
payload.mechanism: docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/spawn-fanout.md Step 5.2 prescribes spawning: run <slot.flow_path>. For the digest-daily slot the schedule SSOT sets flow_path=docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/daily-predict.md, which begins at bootstrap and carries NO dedup gate. The same slot has trigger_prompt=docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/main.md, the universal entry that carries Step pre-D DAILY-PREDICT DEDUP GATE (published:digest-daily:<UTC_DATE>).
payload.impact: Following the flow doc literally on a GUARANTEED daily publish slot skips the FR-P2-7 published-marker gate, leaving only the 24h last_fired boundary as double-publish defense.
payload.evidence: 17:30Z cowork tick 2026-07-25: router spawned via trigger_prompt instead. task_list_held then showed published:digest-daily:2026-07-25 claimed by the agent at 17:40:47Z (TTL 86400). The agent confirmed on completion: task_claim(published:digest-daily:2026-07-25) -> claimed:true, marker held open on purpose per FR-P2-7. Under the flow doc as written that marker would not exist.
remedies_unchosen: Change Step 5.2 to prefer trigger_prompt when present, falling back to flow_path
Repoint digest-daily flow_path at main.md in the schedule SSOT
Move the dedup gate into daily-predict.md so both entrypoints carry it
payload.router_note: Recorded in the 17:30Z cowork telemetry note last tick but never reached the board. Filed here so it is drained rather than lost.
